title: ek aabid ek shabbir
body:
ek aabid ek shabbir
arshaan tay farshaan tay
duniya tay ena warga
koyi nahin
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhenrhaan saamrhnain qatl hoya
ek behnrhaan naal aseer ay
ek laashaa chuk kay asghar da
kar nabiyaan noon hairaan gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chuk kay laash sakina di
utay labda qabrustaan gaya
barhi mushkil naal ay dafn keetay
ek puttar tay ek hamsheer ay
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
<<DIVIDER>>
kainaat ich doon piyo putraan di
nain milrhin hor misaal ay
ek saamnrhnay bhainrh day qatl hoya
ek qaidi bhenrh day naal ay
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roya nok te naizay di
tak bhainrh day khhulay huway waal ay
ek bhainrh yateem di ghurbat tay
rat roya chaalee saal ay
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naizay tay gham karda ay
zainab di parda daari da
karbal ton lay kay sham taen
nain rukda khoon muhaari da
<<DIVIDER>>
dowan piyo putraan nay wekhi ay
dukhi zainab di tashheer ay
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom hussain noon karbal wich
chup ghazi veer di khaagayi ay
baazaaraan tay darbaaraan wich
sajjad noon khoon ruwa gayi ay
o burqay mangdi shamiyaan ton
jiday ghar utri tatheer ay
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir nay karbal wich logo
haey laashay bahattar chaey nay
sir naizay wekh bahattar day
aabid noon ghash wi aaey nay
dowaan sabiraan nay lutdi wekhi
enj zahra di jaageer ay
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
<<DIVIDER>>
islam noon ""hassan"" bachawanrh layi
shabbir nay sab kuj waar dita
kuj zakhmi baal tay phuphiyaan naal
mazloom sajjad jehaad kita
khulay hath shabbir di fauj day san
sajjad di fauj aseer ay
<<MINI>>
do saabir nay kainaat andar ek aabid ek shabbir ay
